summary.result: The results indicated that the silt curtain was not effective in preventing dispersion at flow velocities over 0.5m/s in real conditions.
summary.background: Silt curtains are constructed for minimizing pollution of sediment dispersion in water bodies.
summary.method: In this study, a series of experiments were conducted to investigate hydraulic characteristics around the silt curtains under the different flow conditions.
